lines.en: I come running with my tongue out

lines.zh: 一身蓬松毛发在雪里摆
lines.en: My shaggy coat sways in the snow
My four short legs sink into the snow

lines.zh: 我踩过的雪地留下一串雪花
lines.en: Snowflakes trail where I tread
Ice crystals hang from my tongue
The frost on my fur is a little heavy
I trot just above the snow surface
I circle a fir tree
I bury my nose in the snow and lift it again
I pant and swing my tongue as I run
Snow grains shake off my fur edges

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过结冰的湖面
lines.en: I walk slowly over the frozen lake

lines.zh: 我坐着，舌头还搭在外面
lines.en: I sit with my tongue still hanging out
Frost has whitened my fur tips
I stare blankly by a snowbank
The wind blows and I twitch
I lift a leg to scratch my ear
The snowflakes on the ground have not melted

lines.zh: 我眯眼看着白茫茫一片
lines.en: I squint at all that whiteness
I am waiting for someone with a potato
My tongue has gone a little stiff

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，白雾升起
lines.en: I breathe out and a white cloud rises
I tuck my nose into my fur
I sit facing another way

lines.zh: 我的毛结着薄薄一层霜
lines.en: A thin layer of frost coats my fur
I tilt my head to hear the snow fall
I give a little roll in the snow
I stick my tongue out to catch snowflakes
My fur fluffs up like a puffball

lines.zh: 我抖了抖全身，霜片飞散
lines.en: I shake myself and frost chips fly
Are your hands warm
There is no frost on you
Tongue out, I cannot say much

lines.zh: 你踩到我的雪花轨迹了
lines.en: You stepped on my snowflake trail
I tilt my head at you, fur all puffed
What are you holding, let me smell

lines.zh: 我在雪地里很少见到你
lines.en: I rarely see you out here in the snow
Do not touch my fur, it frosts over
I lean over and sniff your boot
I flick my tongue at you
Are you not cold standing there

lines.zh: 我后退半步又忍不住看你
lines.en: I step back, then cannot help looking again
The pain stiffened my tongue.

lines.zh: 我的一撮毛被扯下来，飘在雪上
lines.en: A tuft of my fur came loose and drifted onto the snow.

lines.zh: 霜壳裂了，里面是我的皮
lines.en: The frost shell cracked to my skin
I curl into a little snowball
I retreat behind a snowbank
Even my tongue pulled back in
This leg is a little lame
This wound is too much for us
I shiver my fur to shake the pain off
I lie down, panting hard
Potato, that is a potato
I smell it, I am running to you
A potato is all it takes to win me
My tongue flaps fast
Where is the potato, I want the potato
I jump to reach your hand
Even the snow cannot slow my feet
Give me one, just one

lines.zh: 我拍着舌头在你脚边打转
lines.en: I flap my tongue and circle at your feet.

lines.zh: 我鼻子快贴到土豆上了
lines.en: My nose is almost against the potato
You knocked me into a roll
You rubbed off a patch of frost

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，毛都乱了
lines.en: We bumped and my fur got mussed
I am not heavy, but neither are you
My tongue slapped against you
I pull back and shake my fur

lines.zh: 我的尾巴被你踩得缩回去
lines.en: You stepped on my tail and it curled right under me.
I bounce softly away

lines.zh: 雪地上我转了两圈才站稳
lines.en: I spun twice on the snow before I got my footing.
Neither of us is hurt, let us run on

lines.zh: 我的舌头碰了碰你的舌头
lines.en: My tongue touched yours

lines.zh: 两只魄罗挤在一起取暖
lines.en: Two snuffles huddle for warmth

lines.zh: 霜在我们之间化了一点
lines.en: The frost between us melted a little
I rest my head against your fur
We sit side by side in the snow
Snowflakes settle on both of us
Your fur is fluffier than mine
We pant together, tongues out

lines.zh: 这片雪原够我们跑很久
lines.en: This snowfield is enough to run in for a long time
I nuzzle your nose
I hold the potato in my mouth
I want to sniff everything on the ground
I run two steps with it in my mouth
Can I eat this thing
I pin it with a paw

lines.zh: 我的舌头把它卷了过来
lines.en: My tongue curls it over to me
I hide it in the snowbank
I hold it and wag my head
This little bit is not enough
I swallowed it
Something is nearing my snowfield
I lift my nose and test the wind
I fix on that shape

lines.zh: 雪花停在半空，我预备跑
lines.en: Snow hangs midair as I ready to run
That smell is off to one side
A puff snorts from my nose
I back up two steps
Who is on my snowfield
I have no fangs, but I can run
I ready myself to charge
I keep following that scent
There are strange tracks in the snow
I dare not come much closer
I approach in a wide circle

lines.zh: 我弓起背，霜毛一根根立着
lines.en: I arch my back, every frosted hair standing up.
I stop and watch what it does
The wind pushed it a little off course
I wait for it to move first
I keep low against the snow
Ready to run, and ready to butt
I lower my head and butt
My weight lands on it
I give it a shove with my head
This charge comes with a faceful of snow

lines.zh: 我咬着它的衣角往后拖
lines.en: I bite its hem and drag backward
I bump once and back away
My frosty fur stings its face
I shake my head to shove it away
I am clumsy but I put my weight in
I shove it crooked with my shoulder
I burrow out of the snowbank
My tongue appears first
A layer of frost has set on me
This snowfield is mine to run
I shake the snow off my back
I found a home in the snow
My fur puffs up like a cloud

lines.zh: 我一落地就开始找土豆
lines.en: The moment I land I start looking for potatoes
Snowflakes scatter around me
I walk out of the snow veil
I pop my head up through the snow
I flick my tongue at the sky

lines.zh: 火苗一舔，我的霜全化了
lines.en: One lick of flame and all my frost melts
I tumbled down the snow slope
Meltwater poured into my nose

lines.zh: 爆炸把雪和我的毛一起掀开
lines.en: The blast threw snow and fur off me

lines.zh: 箭卡在我的厚毛里，拔不出来
lines.en: An arrow lodged in my thick coat and would not come out.

lines.zh: 那股术力让我毛都发烫
lines.en: That magic made my fur burn hot

lines.zh: 找不到土豆，我饿得腿软
lines.en: No potatoes, my legs are weak with hunger

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，霜炸开了
lines.en: Lightning struck and the frost burst off me
My footing slipped and the snowfield is gone
